description: YHCoat-1000 is a two-component, polymer-modified cementitious waterproofing slurry designed for effective waterproofing applications.
whereToUse: Suitable for interior applications such as toilets, bathrooms, kitchens, balconies, floors, flat roof, and floor heating systems
Exterior non-tile and stone facade systems for building walls
It can also be used for maintaining the waterproof layer of underground foundations
notFor: YHCoat-1000 does not provide a traffickable finish. Protect with a leveling screed
YHCoat-1000 is not a decorative treatment
Protect freshly applied material from freezing and rain
advantages: Can be directly applied to wet surfaces, offering excellent impermeability
Smooth application process with fast drying, saving time and labor
Strong adhesion to the substrate, ensuring a durable bond
mixing: Slowly add powder composition (B) to liquid composition (A) in a clean container and mix.
storage: Under normal transportation and storage conditions, the shelf life is a minimum of 12 months.
